tasks.desc: Implement `half_diffs(arr)` that returns `D` where `D[0]=0` and `D[k]` is the sum of the largest `k` minus the sum of the smallest `k` among the first `2k` elements; maintain a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half with running sums, rebalancing after each insertion and recording after every two elements.
For even `N`, read input, call `half_diffs(A)`, and print `D[N//2]`.
For odd `N`, let `L=(N-1)//2`, compute `P=half_diffs(A)` and `S=half_diffs(reversed(A))`, and print `max(P[k]+S[L-k] for k=0..L)`.
Ensure the implementation uses `O(N log N)` time and `O(N)` memory, parses `N` and `A` from stdin, and prints the answer as a 64-bit integer.
